title: Toyota 2016-2022 (Tacoma, Camry, RAV4, Highlander and more): fuel smell from the high-pressure fuel pump, program 23TE01
summary: Toyota Customer Support Program 23TE01: fuel odor in or around the engine bay from low-pressure seepage at the high-pressure fuel pump. If verified, the pump is replaced; coverage runs 10 years from first use regardless of mileage.

specs.name: Program
specs.value: Customer Support Program 23TE01, dealer letter January 26, 2023

specs.name: Coverage
specs.value: 10 years from date of first use, regardless of mileage

specs.name: Vehicles
specs.value: 2016-2022 Tacoma; 2018-2022 Camry; 2019-2022 Avalon; 2017-2022 Highlander; 2020-2022 Highlander Hybrid; 2018-2020 Sienna; 2021-2022 Sienna Hybrid; 2019-2022 RAV4 and RAV4 Hybrid; 2021 RAV4 Prime; 2021-2022 Venza Hybrid

specs.name: Hybrid repair parts
specs.value: Fuel pump assembly (23101-), spacer gasket (23224-), throttle body gasket (22271-); confirm by VIN

specs.name: Salvage / branded title
specs.value: Still eligible: the program is emission related

steps.text: Complaint: fuel smell in or around the engine bay.
Verify the odor is coming from the high-pressure fuel pump; the program only covers verified cases.
Replace the high-pressure fuel pump, with the parts confirmed for that VIN in the Electronic Parts Catalog.

body:
The model/year column of the dealer letter is clear, but its production-period column doesn't line up with the models in the PDF text, so production dates are left out here. Check the VIN with a Toyota dealer for eligibility.

Model names match by substring, so SIENNA here also matches SIENNA HYBRID (covered 2021-2022), and HIGHLANDER matches HIGHLANDER HYBRID (covered 2020-2022).
